findings.current: The System had already pointed the way to our next destination with a Quest as clear as a compass.
findings.defect: The translation omits the narrator’s explicit statement that he had known his answer from the start.
findings.rationale: The source says, “내 대답은 처음부터 정해져 있었다,” before explaining that the System’s Quest pointed to the next destination.
findings.replacement: I’d known my answer from the start. The System had already pointed the way to our next destination with a Quest as clear as a compass.

findings.current: Maybe that was why I’d only just noticed how much more serious his bearing had become, how much deeper his gaze.
findings.defect: The source specifically says Hyuk Sopyung’s aura and gaze had grown more serious and deep. “Bearing” softens or obscures the established aura detail.
findings.rationale: The Korean names 기세 and 눈빛 separately; the glossary allows “aura” for 기세 in this context, and the accepted baseline preserved both details.
findings.replacement: Maybe that was why I’d only just noticed how much more serious his aura had become, how much deeper his gaze.

findings.current: You—you little brat, with the blood barely dry on your head! You dare kill me, your uncle in all but name?!
findings.defect: “With the blood barely dry on your head” is a literal calque of an insult meaning the brat is too young or inexperienced; in English it suggests a physical injury and obscures the insult.
findings.rationale: 대가리에 피도 안 마른 애새끼 is a contemptuous age-based insult, not a claim about a wound.
findings.replacement: You—you little brat, still wet behind the ears! You dare kill me, your uncle in all but name?!

findings.current: I clicked my tongue, turned the first page without thinking, and understood what Sama Pyo had really meant.
findings.defect: The translation drops the narrator’s bitter reaction while turning the page.
findings.rationale: The source says 씁쓸하게 입맛을 다시며, explicitly coloring the action with bitterness.
findings.replacement: I clicked my tongue bitterly, turned the first page without thinking, and understood what Sama Pyo had really meant.

summary: The chapter is largely faithful, with a few small omissions and one idiom rendered as an unclear English calque.
